designObjective: Prove Pokémon TCG as a purpose-specific visual system: an asset-dominant campaign stage, a dense dark search organism, and a long annotated learning sequence, then reuse those rules on a source-independent held-out surface without turning the result into a logo-and-primary-color skin.
visualPriorityOrder: authentic independent asset identity and layer hierarchy
local interaction-state truth without global color invention
responsive section order and specimen prominence

sections.firstImpressionGoal: One authored expansion scene dominates immediately, with navigation, campaign identity, focal subjects, featured card, CTA and slide controls remaining independently legible layers.
mustPreserve: independent navigation, identity, subject, card, CTA and slide-control layers
mustNotDo: use a source screenshot at runtime
flatten the stage into one poster
treat logo or yellow as sufficient brand proof
reuse the stage on utility pages
invent carousel semantics not present in approved action evidence

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A compact, dark, task-first search organism visibly groups query inputs, categorical filters, actions and reversible advanced controls before results.
mustNotDo: convert controls to decorative chips
split the organism into unrelated cards
apply campaign art behind the form
globalize white expanded-label color
fake enabled controls

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A long instructional journey alternates explanation with oversized authentic specimens, with each disclosure visibly attached to the object it explains.
mustNotDo: flatten into an FAQ
make equal marketing cards
detach accordions from specimens
globalize the observed red open-label role
hide specimens on phone

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A fictional deck-lab briefing feels native by combining a compact search organism with an annotated specimen sequence and one bounded campaign-like lead mass, while remaining structurally distinct from every source page.
mustPreserve: at least two approved pattern recipes
mustNotDo: copy a source page composition one-for-one
reuse source screenshots
present fictional content as official
combine all observed colors into a global palette
use logo or official hero as the sole proof

mustPreserve: white limited to database expanded label
red limited to learning open annotation

proofSurfacePlan.desktopCanvas: Independent 1440x900 content captures for Home, Card Database, Learn and held-out pages.
proofSurfacePlan.mobileCanvas: Independent 390x844 content captures plus normal product routes retaining the phone mockup shell.
proofSurfacePlan.inspectorPolicy: Exclude browser chrome, inspector rails, selection overlays, phone bezel and home indicator from source-fidelity crops.
proofSurfacePlan.sourceComparison: Compare mapped source and Demo surfaces at the same viewport and state, with bounded region checks for each high-salience layer.
proofSurfacePlan.heldOutChallenge: Create a clearly fictional Deck Lab page using at least two approved recipes and a new information structure; it must not reuse source screenshots or copy any source composition one-for-one.

orchestratorDecision.colorBoundary: No global brand primary is approved; the observed white and red values remain local disclosure-state roles only.
orchestratorDecision.assetBoundary: Source screenshots remain QA-only. Runtime may use independently inventoried original assets or DOM/CSS reconstruction with provenance.
orchestratorDecision.publication: Keep pokemon-tcg-official-v2 private until Demo self-check, fresh independent Visual QA, three-proof fidelity and release gates all pass.
